rows.label: Kraken Blueprint
rows.alt: or the Mars to Phobos Junction reward

conditions: Kraken is a finished pistol that the Kulstar build consumes, not a blueprint.
Rank the Kraken to 30 before the Kulstar build eats it; it gives its own Mastery and one copy covers both.

groups.activity: Excavation, ideally as a Void Fissure

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: 48 excavator cycles; the payout is flat, so any Excavation node pays the same

conditions: Difficulty does not raise the amount. Pick the easiest node; Steel Path only makes the excavators harder to keep alive.
A Resource Booster and Resourceful or Loyal Retriever double Cryotic even though the game does not show it.
Excavation is poor solo: enemies have to be held off several excavators at once.
bonuses: An Excavation Void Fissure adds +25% in an endless run and cracks relics along the way.
A destroyed excavator still pays in proportion to its run time.

disclosures.title: pace
disclosures.body: A group on Hieracon reports about 3,000 Cryotic in a little over 30 minutes with several excavators going; a random pub fissure reported about 2,700 in 30 minutes. Duviri Circuit pays about a tenth of that, so it is a background trickle only (trigger the fourth excavator for an extra 20 to 40).

rows.label: Tellurium
rows.note: rare drop from Grineer Sealab enemies
rows.alt: or Archwing, Railjack, Kuva Fortress Assault enemies and Reactor Sabotage caches

bonuses: Nekros (Desecrate) with Khora (Pilfering Strangledome) covers both; camp one room, with a booster and blessing.

disclosures.title: Tellurium rates
disclosures.body: Reports run from 9 drops in 20 minutes on Steel Path Ophelia (doubled by a booster) to 30+ in 20 minutes with Nekros, Hydroid and Khora. You need only 2. Archwing Mobile Defense on Neptune (Salacia) gives about 1 to 2 per run.
